lines: This is the first film on the versioned Auric volumes. Version ten builds one typed theory: relations and coherent kernels, Hilbert spaces and probability, record networks, and lastly the future quotient and computation by reflection.
这是 AURIC 版本系列的第一部影片。第十版构建了一套有类型的理论：关系与相干核，Hilbert 空间与概率，记录网络，最后是未来商与反射计算。
Auric version ten: coherent relations and recursive observation.
AURIC V10：相干关系与递归观测。
Five modes, one hidden coupling, three mirrors, and one phase address that makes every state visible.
五个模式，一个隐藏的联合量，三面镜子，以及一个让每个态都可见的相位地址。

Words with no adjacent ones are counted by Fibonacci numbers; at length three they are the five modes. Fixing three occupation means still leaves one sliding direction, set by kappa, the weight of mode one-three.
没有两个相邻 1 的字由 Fibonacci 数计数；长度为三时正是五个模式。固定三个占据均值后，仍留下一个滑动方向，由 κ 决定，即模式 13 的权重。

A response is fixed by those means exactly when its joint coefficient J vanishes. For five quantum modes near the uniform state, with means two fifths, two fifths, one fifth, twenty-one real directions stay invisible: kappa and twenty coherences.
一个响应由这些均值决定，当且仅当它的联合系数 J 为零。在五个量子模式上，在均匀态附近、均值取 2/5、2/5、1/5 时，仍有二十一个实方向不可见：κ 与二十个相干方向。

Coherence enters as a positive kernel: divide out null vectors and labels become vectors with the kernel as inner products, in dimension equal to its rank, unique up to unitary. Pairwise consistency is not enough; this kernel has eigenvalue minus one.
相干以正定核的形式进入。商去零模之后，标签变成向量，其内积就是核，维数等于核的秩，并在酉变换下唯一。两两相容还不够；这个核有特征值 −1。

A complex structure needs a metric and orientation on a real plane; odd dimensions have none, as the determinant of J would square to minus one. Kernel-preserving refinements glue into one Hilbert limit, and lifted readouts keep an outside outcome.
复结构需要实平面上的度量与定向；奇数维没有复结构，因为 (det J)² 会等于 −1。保核的细化拼成唯一的 Hilbert 直极限，提升后的读出要保留一个外部结果。

Probability is a separate input: a normalised weight on effects, additive whenever two effects fit under the identity, is the trace against one unique density operator; a pure preparation gives the squared modulus of the inner product.
概率是另一项输入。一个定义在全部效果上的归一权重，只要两个效果之和不超过单位就可加，那么它就是对唯一密度算子取迹；纯制备时，它给出内积模的平方。

Five modes alone do not select quantum theory: a classical chain on the same Fibonacci tree, for any p between zero and one, has consistent probabilities, positive kernels, a Hilbert limit and a recursive predictor, with commuting readouts.
仅有五个模式并不能选出量子理论。同一棵 Fibonacci 树上的经典链，p 取 0 与 1 之间任意值，都有相容的概率、正定核、Hilbert 极限和递归预测者，而所有读出仍彼此交换。

An observation atom is an instrument, not just an effect. Complete positivity means a positive Choi matrix and a Kraus form, with smallest environment the Choi rank. Identity and reset share the effect identity yet leave different states.
观测原子是一个仪器，而不只是一个效果。完全正性等价于 Choi 矩阵半正定以及 Kraus 形式，最小环境维数等于 Choi 秩。恒等通道与重置通道有相同的效果 I，留下的态却不同。

Quantum lifts of a classical function are positive matrices with identity blocks on the fibres. For NAND, a vector z of norm at most one remains: four environment dimensions, or three when z has norm one, giving a perfect logical qubit.
经典函数的量子延拓就是在各纤维上为单位块的半正定矩阵。对 NAND（纤维大小三和一），剩下一个范数不超过一的向量 z：环境需要四维；当 z 的范数为一时只需三维，并给出一个完美的逻辑 qubit。

A static network needs no clock: every topological order of a typed acyclic network gives the same channel, while operations on one wire keep their order. Edge phases up to gauge are fixed by loop holonomies.
静态网络不需要时钟。有类型无环网络的任意拓扑排序都给出同一个通道，同一条线上的操作仍保持次序。边相位在规范意义下由闭环 holonomy 决定。

The five-mode graph has five edges on five vertices, so one loop. With one fixed phase per site its holonomy is always one; a second phase direction at one site adds a relative phase no gauge removes.
五模式图有五条边、五个顶点，所以只有一个闭环。每个位置固定一个相位时，它的 holonomy 恒为一。在某个位置加入第二个相位方向，会带来一个任何规范都消不掉的相对相位。

From mode zero, arrival at one-three starts as t to the fourth over four, times A squared plus B squared plus two A B cosine phi. Conjugating the Hamiltonian changes no such reading, so phi and minus phi look alike.
从模式 0 出发，到达 13 的概率起始为 t⁴/4 · (A² + B² + 2AB cos Φ)。把 Hamiltonian 取复共轭，这类读出都不改变，所以 Φ 与 −Φ 看起来一样。

A path record with overlap gamma scales the fringe: two settings read the product h gamma, with visibility proportional to its size. A hidden record gives the intended gate exactly when every Gram entry is one.
重叠为 γ 的路径记录会缩放干涉条纹：两次设置读出乘积 hγ，可见度与 |γ| 成正比。隐藏的记录恰好在每个 Gram 元素都为一时，才精确给出指定的门。

An observer holds only what future tests can tell apart. Pull terminal effects back through every allowed word: the span stops within d squared minus r zero steps, and two states are equivalent exactly when they agree on it.
观察者只掌握未来测试能区分的东西。把终端效果沿每个允许的字拉回：张成空间在 d² − r₀ 步之内停止增长；两个态等价，当且仅当它们在这个空间上取值相同。

The quotient updates linearly with r minus one affine coordinates; a k-dimensional quantum memory needs k squared at least r. Moving state, ruler and controls together changes nothing, and a joint unknown is not two averages: one versus one half.
这个商按线性规则自我更新，需要 r − 1 个仿射坐标；k 维量子记忆需要 k² ≥ r。把状态、尺子和控制一起换帧不改变任何读出；共同的未知也不等于两个平均：一对一半。

Complete instruments make prefix probabilities consistent, defining one measure on infinite record histories, and the prediction of a fixed question converges in mean square to the best the records allow.
完整仪器使前缀概率相容，从而在无限记录历史上定义唯一的测度；对一个固定问题的预测在均方意义下收敛到记录所允许的最佳预测。

Flipping with X never settles. A contraction by lambda below one settles: with step errors epsilon, the distance ends at most epsilon over one minus lambda. Postselection on probability at least eta can inflate an error delta to two delta over eta.
永远用 X 翻转就不会稳定。收缩系数 λ < 1 的映射会稳定：每步误差为 ε 时，到固定态的距离最终至多为 ε/(1 − λ)。以至少 η 的概率后选择，误差 δ 可能被放大到至多 2δ/η。

Two reflections at angle theta rotate by two theta, but powers of one gate commute and two fixed involutions never fill the unitaries. Three reflections, Z and two tilted by an irrational alpha toward X and Y, are dense; three is the minimum.
夹角为 θ 的两次反射给出 2θ 的旋转。但一个门的幂彼此交换，两个固定对合也填不满酉群。三个反射——Z，以及以角 α（α/π 为无理数）分别倾向 X 和 Y 的两个——生成稠密群，而三是最少数目。
Natively, a pi pulse on the middle site sends zero zero zero to the helper and back with a minus sign: on the code, the gate minus one, one, one, one. Two pulses on each side make it C Z.
原生地，中位上的 π 脉冲把 000 送到辅助模式再带回来，并留下一个负号：在代码上就是 diag(−1, 1, 1, 1)。两侧各加两个脉冲，就把它变成 CZ。

With every phase zero, controlled Y costs seven pulses and three make a swap. One Y address then compiles any known circuit, forty-two pulses per unit of distance plus five per C Z; without it, the plus state stays at least one half away.
所有相位为零时，受控 Y 需要七个脉冲，三个受控 Y 组成一次交换。再加一个 Y 地址就能编译任何已知电路，每单位距离四十二个脉冲，每个 CZ 再加五个；没有它，加态始终相差至少 1/2 的迹距离。

On one atom, three zero-phase rotations generate only a twisted copy of SO five. A fourth-order phase on mode one-three completes the control: all unitaries with determinant a fourth root of unity, so every unitary channel.
在单个五模式原子上，三个零相位旋转只生成 SO(5) 的一个扭转副本。在模式 13 上加一个四阶相位就补全了控制：得到所有行列式为四次单位根的酉矩阵，从而得到每个五维酉通道。

Order matters: pulse two then pulse one sends mode zero to mode two, the reverse to mode one. The address also changes what an observer sees: zero-phase menus reach at most d times d plus one over two directions, the address all d squared.
次序很重要：先脉冲 2 再脉冲 1，把模式 0 送到模式 2；反过来的次序则送到模式 1。相位地址还改变观察者能看到的东西：零相位菜单至多达到 d(d + 1)/2 个方向，加上这个地址则是全部 d² 个。

Reporting a rational parameter exactly needs at least k minus d exact queries; finitely many noisy ones never suffice, and a countable snapshot cannot restore a forgotten noise sample. Full root identification remains open.
要精确报告一个有理参数，至少需要 k − d 次精确查询；有限次带噪查询永远不够，可数快照也无法恢复已遗忘的噪声样本。完整的原根识别仍未解决。

A hidden kappa, kernels as vectors, effects as densities, instruments with records, clockless networks, loop phases, the future quotient, settling predictions, three mirrors, one phase address, and the price of exactness.
隐藏的 κ，变成向量的核，变成密度算子的效果，带记录的仪器，无时钟的网络，闭环相位，未来商，趋于稳定的预测，三面镜子，一个相位地址，以及精确知识的代价。

The effect form of Gleason's theorem, the Choi and Stinespring forms and the elementary-gate decompositions are published inputs, the rest is argued in the theory volume, and the finite computations were redone for this film.
效果版 Gleason 定理、Choi 与 Stinespring 表示以及基本门分解是已发表的输入，其余结论在理论卷中论证，有限计算都为本片重新做过。
